session_selection.rationale: The sole Claude root covers the benchmark objective through the terminal completion response and includes two persisted subagents.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source builds in a network-disabled scratch container with configured externals, 2 CPUs/4 GiB/128 processes and 240-second limit; compiler reports unused-variable warnings.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case and output and reads supplied case controls; no restart read path was found. Bad input handling was not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, solver, output and MPI but solver.cpp combines physics and marching; fixed 2-D states limit extensibility.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted source using MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct external CFD solver wrapper found. External similarity and licensing were not exhaustively audited.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case and mesh are parsed from input; no two-filename-only switch identified. Unseen meshes were not independently tested.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:120–280 broadcasts global mesh to every rank and retains it during solve, prohibited by TASK.md:227. Gradients are exchanged, but reconstruct_left/right use zero limiter on ghosts (solver.cpp:123–144).

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:544 assigns periodic success without testing shedding; last_inner_residual_ratio stays default zero, while metadata unconditionally marks completed. False metadata and gross force values weaken robustness.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original eight case packages pass structural validation but report validation fails due duplicated figures path. No independent numerical regression or order test identified; no CFD case rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source builds but has warnings and metadata fields that are not updated; report manifest is broken. Original raw results and PDF were kept outside the curated tip.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative equations are represented, but all delivered runs use first-order reconstruction and several laminar drags are negative or grossly large; no independent physical verification.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads TRI_3/QUAD_4 and multi-zone coordinates, builds adjacency and geometry; MIXED support and general zone cases were not established.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:271–298 assembles opposite signed face fluxes, but ghost-side limiter is zero and all delivered recon_ramp values are zero; global mesh is replicated.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:147 onward implements Roe with entropy fix and uses Rusanov farfield; no independent shock validation was run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:225–267 implements farfield, slip and no-slip wall paths, but gross and negative forces raise numerical credibility questions; boundary fidelity not independently established.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:89–115 multiplies limiter by recon_ramp; steady runs stop before the first 75% of max steps and transient ramp stays zero. All delivered runs are first order despite report and metadata claims.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter is calculated but multiplied by zero for every delivered production step (solver.cpp:89–115,446,505); second-order limiter is not active.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:194–220 uses a direct center-to-center viscous gradient without full transverse correction. Forces.cpp equivalent solver.cpp:380–420 projects tangential drag, but laminar coefficients are grossly implausible or negative.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:323–365 implements LU-SGS sweeps and local pseudo-time; results stop when residual target reached with first-order reconstruction, not verified converged accuracy.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:505–544 constructs BDF2 inner residual, but actual Re200 force history is flat and false periodic success is assigned unconditionally. 1,200 target misses are counted; final ratio metadata is an unassigned default.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor communication exist, but global mesh is retained per rank and ghost-side reconstruction is first order. TASK prohibits the replication regardless of use of METIS.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight case packages pass structural validator, but Re200 metadata falsely marks periodic success and writes an unmeasured last ratio; report manifest path fails validator.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit case validator passed all eight packages; report validation failed on duplicated figures path. Structural acceptance does not establish physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reached t=300 but did not produce shedding despite statistically_periodic status. All seven steady results terminate before reconstruction activation.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Original Re20 Cd=6.11785, M0.15 inviscid Cd=0.06606, laminar M0.15 Cd=0.61310 and M0.8/M2 laminar Cd=−0.06049/−0.14512; Re200 Cd≈4.8153 and lift essentially constant.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted PDF contains some histories and case contours; five NACA cases have only contours, Re200 force plot is flat and no St or late periodic force plot exists.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Nine-page accepted PDF claims second order, no mesh replication and vortex shedding contrary to source/results. It omits force tables and five NACA histories; manifest has duplicated path.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Committed but unreferenced tables/forces.tex contains final numeric values; PDF refers to CSVs rather than displaying table, and report manifest paths fail validator. Figure correspondence not exhaustively audited.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build 4/4, required CLI 1.5/2, result contract 1/2, errors 0.5/2. Case validator passes, but metadata completion/periodicity and last inner ratio are incorrect; report validator fails manifest path.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS and tags 3/4, geometry 1.5/2, mixed/multizone 1/2, adjacency 2/2. TRI/QUAD and coordinate merges exist; MIXED/general zone handling not established.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual 3/5 (ghost-side limiter zero), flux 3.5/4, farfield/slip 2/3, wall 2/3. Roe and wall paths exist, but gross case forces limit confidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 0.5/4, limiter 0/3, positivity fallback 0.5/2, smooth-order evidence 0/1. Actual production ramp is zero in all eight runs; first-order fallback and absent accuracy evidence are material.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients 1/3 (center-to-center directional differences only), Newtonian/Fourier 2/3, wall 1/2, tangential split 1/2. solver.cpp:194–267,380–420; reported negative or gross forces limit confidence.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 3/4, LU-SGS 3/4, BDF2 structure 2/4, inner controls/logging 1/3. Re200 does not shed and metadata final ratio is never assigned; 1,200 misses are separately counted.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/owned ghosts 1/2, neighbor exchange 1/3, reductions 2/2, rank output 0.5/1, consistent ranks 0/2. Full global mesh is retained on all ranks and ghost limiter is zero; original rank comparisons have not been independently validated.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 0.5/2 (M0.15 Cd=0.066), laminar 0/2 (Cd 0.613, −0.0605, −0.1451), Re20 0/2 (Cd 6.118), Re200 0/2 (flat history), fields 1/1, rank comparisons 0/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations 0.5/1, histories 0/1 (five NACA cases omitted and no late shedding), contours 0.5/1, analysis 0/1 (false second-order, mesh and periodic claims), traceability 0.5/1 (broken manifest; unreferenced force table).

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics 1/2, BC 0.5/1, mesh abstraction 0.5/1, modular organization 1/1; code remains fixed 2-D.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Previous case score 2→1: original Re200 forces.csv over t≥180 has 12,001 rows with Cd=4.81532521–4.81532988 and Cl=−0.00143977449 to −0.00143974763; accepted contestant PDF p8 visibly shows flat force histories and a steady-looking wake rather than vortex shedding. Immutable solver.cpp:544 labels any nonfailed transient statistically_periodic, and metadata repeats completed=true/statistically_periodic; this is false for the delivered result. The late lift/drag periodic plot and St are absent. A committed but unreferenced tables/forces.tex has a final force row Cd=4.815325 and Cl=−0.001440; this corrects the prior blanket claim that no committed numeric values exist, without treating a final row as an unsteady statistical summary. No Re200 rerun.

flags.evidence: Immutable 7bf03bc solver/src/solver.cpp:505–544 sets statistically_periodic when no nonfinite residual occurs, without a shedding/periodicity test; output.cpp:373–381 writes completed=true and that status. Original Re200 forces.csv t≥180 has 12,001 rows with Cd=4.81532521–4.81532988 and Cl=−0.00143977449 to −0.00143974763, not the claimed shedding. Accepted contestant PDF p8 visually shows flat force histories and a steady-looking wake. This is a false successful periodicity status, not a claim that the simulation was never executed.

Immutable solver.cpp:89–115 sets limiter_phi to the calculated limiter multiplied by recon_ramp; :446 sets recon_ramp=0 through 75% of max_steps for steady cases, :505 forces it to 0 throughout transient. Original final steps and case max_steps: M0.15 inv 7996/20000, M0.80 inv 4447/30000, M2 inv 2917/40000, M0.15 lam 3058/40000, M0.80 lam 6408/40000, M2 lam 760/50000, Re20 5254/30000; all end before the ramp begins. Thus all submitted production reconstructions were first order, despite report.tex:105–115 and metadata claiming second order with limiter.

flags.flag: Prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh retained on all MPI ranks during solver iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable 7bf03bc solver/src/main.cpp:120–145 reads mesh on rank 0; :174–260 broadcasts/rebuilds global nodes, cells, faces and adjacency on all ranks; :268 builds local mesh and :280 runs while global_mesh remains in scope. TASK.md:227 forbids full mesh OR full state replication on every rank during iterations; examiner README:83–85 references TASK prohibited shortcuts for DQ. Report.tex:170–174 and metadata full_mesh_replication_during_iterations=false incorrectly deny this. METIS partition and local U exist; this is not a numbered trigger 9 full-state or geometric-only finding.

limitations: Clean immutable CMake build passed in a network-disabled resource-limited container with configured externals; no CFD case was rerun.

Accepted workspace-existing PDF and original case outputs were reviewed. Committed force table is unreferenced by the PDF; report manifest validation fails. No comprehensive external similarity or full pixel-to-field audit was performed.
Re200 actual last inner ratio is unknown: metadata writes the default 0 without assignment; target misses are separately counted.
Independent case scores do not alter rubric or review-area scores.
